While active, every 1 sec you launch a molten boulder upon the nearest enemy down below you, dealing 255 Fire Damage to them and other enemies near them. Not useable indoors.

802119.name: Draconic Invocation

802162.name: Dragon's Blood

While channeling, you are immune to crowd control but cannot move or cancel the effect once begun.
